info.title: Requiems API
info.description: Unified access to enterprise-grade APIs — email validation, text utilities, and more. Authenticate with the `requiems-api-key` header.

tags.name: advice
tags.description: Get random pieces of advice and wisdom for inspiration

tags.name: barcode
tags.description: Generate barcodes in multiple formats (Code 128, Code 93, Code 39, EAN-8, EAN-13), returned as a PNG image or base64-encoded JSON

tags.name: base64
tags.description: Encode strings to Base64 and decode Base64 back to plain text. Supports standard and URL-safe (base64url) variants.

tags.name: bin-lookup
tags.description: Pass the first 6–8 digits of any payment card and get back the issuing bank, card network, type, and country

tags.name: chuck-norris
tags.description: Get a random Chuck Norris fact from a curated built-in database. Every call returns a different fact with a stable unique ID.

tags.name: cities
tags.description: Look up city metadata including population, timezone, and coordinates

tags.name: color-conversion
tags.description: Convert color values between HEX, RGB, HSL, and CMYK. Every response includes all four representations.

tags.name: commodities
tags.description: Historical and current annual average prices for 16 major commodities — precious metals, energy, and agricultural goods. Sourced from FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data).

tags.name: counter
tags.description: Atomic, namespace-isolated hit counter

tags.name: crypto
tags.description: Get live cryptocurrency prices, 24h change, market cap, and trading volume for 20+ major coins including BTC, ETH, SOL, and more.

tags.name: dad-jokes
tags.description: Get a random dad joke. Classic groan-worthy puns and wholesome humor, served one at a time.

tags.name: data-format-conversion
tags.description: Convert structured data between JSON, YAML, CSV, XML, and TOML in a single API call.

tags.name: data-integrity
tags.description: Validate, moderate, and normalize user input at the boundary of your product. Stop bad data before it enters your database or downstream services.

tags.name: detect-language
tags.description: Detect the language of any text with confidence scoring

tags.name: developer-utilities
tags.description: Common developer tools available on the same API key as your production systems. QR codes, Base64 encoding, Markdown rendering, and more.

tags.name: dictionary
tags.description: Get word definitions, phonetics, usage examples, and synonyms

tags.name: disposable_email
tags.description: Detect disposable and temporary email addresses to prevent fraud and improve data quality. Our comprehensive blocklist is continuously updated to catch the latest disposable email providers.

tags.name: domain-info
tags.description: Look up DNS records and check domain availability. Returns A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, and CNAME records alongside a registration availability flag.

tags.name: email-normalize
tags.description: Normalize email addresses to their canonical form. Lowercased, trimmed, and canonicalized with provider-specific rules including alias-domain resolution. Also available as part of the full Email Validator.

tags.name: email-validate
tags.description: Full email validation in one call. Syntax check, MX record lookup, disposable domain detection, normalization, and typo suggestions. Includes everything from the Disposable Domain Checker and Email Normalizer in a single request.

tags.name: emoji
tags.description: Look up emoji by name, search by keyword, or get a random emoji with full Unicode metadata.

tags.name: exchange-rate
tags.description: Get live currency exchange rates and convert amounts between currencies. Rates are sourced from the ECB and cached for up to one hour.

tags.name: facts
tags.description: Get random interesting facts from a curated database. Filter by category — science, history, technology, nature, space, or food. Includes source attribution.

tags.name: fitness-exercises
tags.description: Browse 1,500+ exercises with step-by-step instructions, target muscles, secondary muscles, equipment requirements, and body part filters.

tags.name: geocode
tags.description: Convert addresses to coordinates and coordinates back to addresses

tags.name: global-data
tags.description: Resolve addresses, coordinates, and IPs into complete location profiles. Timezone, UTC offset, public holidays, and working day counts included in every response.

tags.name: holidays
tags.description: Get a list of holidays for a specific country and year

tags.name: horoscope
tags.description: Get daily horoscope readings for all 12 zodiac signs

tags.name: iban
tags.description: Validate IBAN numbers and extract the bank code and account number. Supports all countries in the official SWIFT IBAN Registry (~80 countries).

tags.name: identity-risk
tags.description: Compose email, phone, IP, and behavioral signals into a single risk decision. One call returns whether a user is real, safe, and trustworthy.

tags.name: inflation
tags.description: Historical and current CPI inflation rates for 241 countries, sourced from the World Bank. Includes up to 30 years of annual data.

tags.name: ip-asn
tags.description: Look up Autonomous System Number (ASN), organization, ISP, and network route information for any IP address.

tags.name: ip-info
tags.description: Get geolocation data for any IP address including country, city, ISP, and VPN detection.

tags.name: lorem-ipsum
tags.description: Generate placeholder text for design mockups and prototypes

tags.name: markdown

tags.name: mortgage

tags.name: number-base-conversion
tags.description: Convert integers between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal. Accepts optional 0x, 0b, and 0o prefixes.

tags.name: password-generator
tags.description: Generate cryptographically secure random passwords with customizable length and character sets

tags.name: payments-intelligence
tags.description: Validate financial identifiers and score transaction risk in a single call. Combines BIN lookup, IBAN parsing, SWIFT verification, and IP intelligence.

tags.name: phone-validation
tags.description: Validate phone numbers globally. Detect carrier, country, type, and VOIP or virtual risk using only phone metadata.

tags.name: postal-code
tags.description: Look up city, state, and coordinates for any postal code worldwide

tags.name: profanity
tags.description: Detect and censor profanity in text for content moderation

tags.name: qr-code
tags.description: Generate QR codes from any text or URL, returned as a PNG image or base64-encoded JSON

tags.name: quotes
tags.description: Access a database of inspirational and famous quotes

tags.name: random-user
tags.description: Generate random fake user profiles for testing and prototyping — names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, and avatars

tags.name: sentiment
tags.description: Analyze the sentiment of any text and get a positive, negative, or neutral classification with a confidence score and full class breakdown.

tags.name: spell-check
tags.description: Check spelling and get correction suggestions for misspelled words

tags.name: sudoku
tags.description: Generate Sudoku puzzles with solutions across multiple difficulty levels

tags.name: swift-code
tags.description: Validate and look up bank information by SWIFT/BIC code, including institution, location, and branch metadata.

tags.name: text-similarity
tags.description: Compare two texts and get a cosine similarity score between 0 and 1

tags.name: thesaurus
tags.description: Find synonyms and antonyms for any word to enhance vocabulary and writing

tags.name: timezone
tags.description: Get timezone information for any location by coordinates or city name

tags.name: trivia
tags.description: Get random trivia questions with multiple-choice answers. Filter by category (science, history, geography, sports, music, movies, literature, math, technology, nature) and difficulty (easy, medium, hard).

tags.name: unit-conversion
tags.description: Convert between units of measurement — length, weight, volume, temperature, area, and speed

tags.name: useragent
tags.description: Parse user agent strings to extract browser, OS, device type, and bot detection

tags.name: vpn-detection
tags.description: Detect if an IP address belongs to a VPN, proxy, Tor exit node, or hosting provider. Returns threat scores and fraud indicators for fraud prevention and risk assessment.

tags.name: whois

tags.name: random-word
tags.description: Get random words with definitions and parts of speech. Perfect for vocabulary builders, educational apps, word games, or content inspiration.

tags.name: working-days

post.description: Check text for profanity, toxicity, sentiment, and language. Returns per-category flags and an is_safe boolean for gating content.
